item.tib: zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba'i dkar chag rdo rje 'bar ba'i phreng ba
item.coloph: o rgyan bde chen gling pas sa rta hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu dgur zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba'i mgul nas gter du spyan drangs te skal ldan gyi bu mchog gser khyung dbra rigs mi yi dbang po be hu btsan rgyal grags pa'i thugs dgyes slad du shog ser dkyus su mtho gang zheng du sor phyed do yig phreng gsum du 'dug pa la slar nor bu sgar du brda yig bod yig bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel rgyas shog/
